description: This file defines a translation memory system for managing localized text entries, including loading from and saving to a file, as well as retrieving and storing translation entries based on cache keys.

classes.name: TMEntry
classes.description: Represents a single translation memory entry containing source text, translation, metadata, and associated keys.

classes.name: TranslationMemory
classes.description: Manages a collection of translation memory entries, supporting load, save, retrieval, and insertion operations.

methods.name: LoadTranslationMemory
methods.description: Loads translation memory entries from a specified file path, parsing JSON lines into TMEntry objects.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a translation entry by cache key, returning the entry if it exists and has a non-empty translation.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a translation entry in the memory, based on its cache key.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves all translation entries to the associated file path in a sorted JSON lines format.
